new_results.statement: For symmetric anchored Z over F2, rank(Z)=1 iff Z_ij=Z_0i Z_0j for all 1<=i<=j<=N.

After quotienting symmetry, Z00=1 and Zii=Z0i, Boolean degree-2 moment points affinely span the full reduced moment space; no additional universal affine linear cut separates rank-one from all spurious points.
Among all 51 affine subspaces T of F2^3, T intersect AND is non-affine only for FULL and four planes p=0,p=x,p=y,p=x+y+1.
new_results.plane_currency: Each hard plane is exactly one binary Krom clause after enforcing p=xy.

new_results.statement: If affine product absorption leaves no FULL product and the projected live Krom boundary is 2-affine, exact decision/search reduces to 2-SAT plus Gaussian lifting in polynomial time.
Relax either NO-FULL or 2-AFFINE alone and exact linear-size arbitrary-3CNF representations reappear.

new_results.axis_B: NO-FULL + width-3 affine via E9 Krom+XOR3 and defect-plane realization.
